notes.text: SUB-SECTORS (Art. 46 of the renewal 2024-2027 signed 18 February 2025, pp. 21-25): the calzature table is modelled as the base_salary_by_subsector calzature (EmployerProfile.subsector), page 21 read on its image. Not modelled: the pelli e cuoio, occhiali and giocattoli tables (pp. 21-25, the first two replaced by the verbale of 21 February 2025), whose levels (4s; no 2bis, 3bis, 8) differ from the file's.

limitation.remediation: Model the pelli e cuoio, occhiali and giocattoli tables with their own levels, then remove this note.

notes.text: VV.PP. (Venditori Viaggiatori e Piazzisti) levels excluded; only Jan-2026 data available from primary sources, historical tranches not found.
APPRENTICESHIP: not modelled (set to []). Primary source for post-2024 apprenticeship rules not identified.
SALARY MODEL: conglobated (single minimo mensile, no separate contingenza or EDR). Source: lavoro-economia.it explicitly divides monthly by 173 to derive hourly rate, no separate component columns.
LEVEL 1: jumps to 1558.00 EUR/month at Jan 2025 (9.006 EUR/h, exceeds 9 EUR/h floor per CCNL art. 33bis). Frozen in Jan 2026 and Jan 2027 — excluded from standard tranche mechanism.
LEVEL 8 IDF: indennità di funzione 51.65 EUR modelled as fixed_allowance (unverified for period before Jan 2026). Function-conditional, not automatic for all L8 workers.

limitation.remediation: Gate IND_FUN by a role (function holders) and source the pre-Jan 2026 amount, or record the limitation.

notes.text: FONDAPI: the contributions are computed on the contractual minimum of the level; the Fondapi base also counts the EDR, not in the bundle pay.

The Fondapi base ('retribuzione Fondapi' or 'elemento retributivo nazionale') counts the EDR besides the minimum; the bundle pay of this CCNL does not hold them, so the fund contributions of an enrolled worker are computed on the minimum alone and understated.

limitation.remediation: Model the EDR in the pay of the CCNL and add them to the Fondapi base, then remove this note.

findings: The review recorded no list of the documents it read.

reviews.scope: The minimi of the ten levels of the settore tessili e abbigliamento against the signed renewal of 18 February 2025.
findings: Settore tessili e abbigliamento (PDF p. 21 of the signed scan, checked on the page image): the 38 minimi of the file, from the minimi of 1/02/2022 to 1/01/2027, match and move from assumed to verified. Level 1 is a flat 1.558,00 from 2025 with no increment printed. The errata of 21/2/2025 (pp. 24-25) does not touch this table.
The ruleset names this source, published by FILCTEM-CGIL, a signatory: source_type contracting_party instead of estimated.

reviews.scope: Art. 46 calzature table of the renewal 2024-2027 (p. 21, page image).
findings: The calzature employers pay their own minimi (level 8 2,431.61 from 2025, not the tessile 2,421.56).
